mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 59 degrees outside with overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School, and we are currently seeing a Waxing Gibbous moon tonight.

The City of Verona is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for students in grades K through 12, with the top design from four categories being printed for the November election. Interested students must submit their original designs by July 22, and the community will vote on the winners between July 28 and August 7.

You have a busy few days ahead with live music happening today at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking forward, the Dane County Farmers Market takes place tomorrow, followed by more live music at Paddy Mac's later in the week.

In a report covering July 13 through July 20, the Verona Police Department noted that on July 13, a 36-year-old Madison man was arrested for his first O-W-I offense after his vehicle became stuck on a rock.
Today's delicious flavor is Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM today.
